notes: Official Towzen menu and Sydney pages were checked on 2026-07-07. The Sydney page describes Towzen Vegan Ramen as 100% plant-based and free from alliums.
The official menu lists vegan ramen, udon, rice, sides, and salads with ingredients and descriptions, but no serving sizes, calories, kJ, protein, carbohydrate, or fat values.
The site is built on WordPress, WooCommerce, and Elementor; visible menu HTML and available page metadata did not expose nutrition fields.
A social search snippet claimed around 520 calories for one ramen bowl, but it did not provide protein or a per-item official nutrition source, so it is not importable.

Do not import until exact menu-item calories and protein are found; vegan ramen estimates would be low confidence because broth, noodle quantity, oil, sesame, nuts, tofu, and tempeh toppings vary heavily.
